name: Storm Titan Thunder Tempest

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

hit.description: lightning and thunder damage, and the target is pushed 3 squares and dazed (save ends)

effect.description: The storm titan thunder tempest makes a basic attack, teleports half its speed, and makes a basic attack against a different target;

powers.name: Sheet of Lightning
powers.usageDetails: when the storm titan thunder tempest uses thunder tempest

hit.description: lightning damage, the target is knocked prone, and the target takes ongoing 10 thunder damage and is deafened (save ends both).

effect.description: The thunder tempest teleports to a square adjacent to or in the burst

powers.name: Lightning Flesh
powers.trigger: when hit by a melee attack

effect.description: Targets triggering attacker; +24 vs. Reflex; 1d10 + 5 lightning damage, 1d10 + 5 thunder damage, and the target is pushed 2 squares.

The storm titan thunder tempest takes the form of a Gargantuan thunder cloud, then flies its speed. While in this form, it is insubstantial and can occupy spaces occupied by other creatures. A creature that shares a square with the cloud loses lightning resistance (save ends). A creature that starts its turn in the thunder tempest’s space is slid 3 squares. The storm titan thunder tempest resumes its titan form immediately after making an attack other than lightning flesh.
Thunder tempest recharges and the storm titan uses it. The titan’s attacks deal 10 extra thunder damage until the end of the encounter.
